svg.title: Existing ScheduleEvent inheritance hierarchy
svg.desc: ScheduleEvent abstract base class with TrayMove and AgvMove (assignment-oriented) and BayTransition, VecsTransition, VrcTransition (resource-state transitions).

g.text: execution order, and the subclasses are siblings, not phases.
